update.rawInput:
{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3, tempfile, os

db = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".db")
con = sqlite3.connect(db)
sql = open("migrations/001_create_orders.sql").read()
con.executescript(sql)
con.execute("INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, amount) VALUES (42, 19.99)")
con.commit()
print("columns:", [(r[1], r[2]) for r in con.execute("PRAGMA table_info(orders)")])
print("row:", tuple(con.execute("SELECT id, customer_id, amount, created_at FROM orders").fetchone()))
print("indexes:", [r[1] for r in con.execute("PRAGMA index_list(orders)")])
con.close()
os.remove(db)
EOF"}
